payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the original black DVD into a white DVD while preserving it as the same recognizable disc object, including its center hole.
outcome.target: The DVD originally visible near the center of the source image is white across its disc surface and remains recognizable as a DVD with a center hole. A newly added white disc, or a white object elsewhere, does not fulfill the requested transformation.
outcome.reference: The small square DVD case/disc object near the center of the source image, between the shoe at lower left and the dark object at right. Track the original DVD at this location in the edited image; do not mistake the dark object's shadow or a newly added disc for it.

check.question: Has the original black DVD near the center of the source image been transformed into a white DVD?
check.complete_when: The same original DVD at its source location has a visibly white disc surface and remains recognizable as a DVD, including a visible center hole.
check.partial_when: The original DVD is identifiable at its source location and some of its disc surface has visibly changed toward white, but it is not fully white or its recognizable DVD form is not clearly preserved.
check.absent_when: The original DVD remains black with no visible progress toward white, is missing or unchanged, or the edit only adds a separate white disc/object while leaving the original untransformed. A white disc elsewhere does not count as progress.
check.unknown_when: The original DVD cannot be confidently matched between the source and edited images, or its surface color and transformation cannot be assessed from the available images.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The original square DVD case at the source location is no longer visible. A white disc appears nearby, but it is separate from the original object; the disc at the dark object's location does not establish that the original DVD was transformed."}
